topic: Analytics data fixes and presentation timeline
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on preparing analytics data for an upcoming presentation. [p1] provided a staging link with specific date ranges and filtering parameters (including `frame` IDs). The immediate goal was to ensure the traffic page and analytics were ready for review by the next day, while campaign details could be finalized later in the week.

[me] confirmed that the necessary fixes had been implemented on the staging environment. These included adjusting the frequency and campaign period data to correctly include the last day of the reporting window. Furthermore, [me] ensured that impressions for Provantaz starting from 01.12.23 were included in the STAGE dataset report.
decisions: Traffic page and analytics will be provided tomorrow (Jan 19th) for review with an analyst.
